arguments.label: 近七天运营指标
arguments.sql:
-- 整体五指标参考。日期和主播范围由工具注入，不读取物理表。
WITH watch_day AS (
  SELECT date, streamer_id, SUM(duration_seconds) AS watch_seconds
  FROM watch_events GROUP BY date, streamer_id
), watch_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(duration_seconds) / 3600.0 AS watch_duration_hours,
         COUNT(DISTINCT viewer_id) AS viewer_uv FROM watch_events
), gift_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount_idr) AS gift_amount_idr FROM gift_events
), live_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(b.live_seconds) / 3600.0 AS live_duration_hours,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.live_seconds > 0 AND b.live_seconds >= :min_live_seconds
                   AND COALESCE(w.watch_seconds, 0) >= :min_watch_seconds THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS effective_live_days
  FROM broadcast_days b LEFT JOIN watch_day w ON b.date = w.date AND b.streamer_id = w.streamer_id
)
SELECT 'all' AS dimension, COALESCE(g.gift_amount_idr, 0) AS gift_amount_idr,
       COALESCE(w.watch_duration_hours, 0) AS watch_duration_hours,
       COALESCE(l.effective_live_days, 0) AS effective_live_days,
       COALESCE(l.live_duration_hours, 0) AS live_duration_hours, w.viewer_uv
FROM live_total l CROSS JOIN watch_total w CROSS JOIN gift_total g

arguments.label: 助推更新待审核清单
arguments.sql:
-- 最近七天主播级指标与昨日实际额度；规则仅产生待审核建议。
WITH watch_day AS (
  SELECT date, streamer_id, SUM(duration_seconds) AS watch_seconds FROM watch_events GROUP BY date, streamer_id
), watches AS (
  SELECT streamer_id, SUM(duration_seconds) / 3600.0 AS watch_duration_hours,
         COUNT(DISTINCT viewer_id) AS viewer_uv FROM watch_events GROUP BY streamer_id
), gifts AS (
  SELECT streamer_id, SUM(amount_idr) AS gift_amount_idr FROM gift_events GROUP BY streamer_id
), live AS (
  SELECT b.streamer_id, SUM(b.live_seconds) / 3600.0 AS live_duration_hours,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.live_seconds > 0 AND b.live_seconds >= :min_live_seconds
                  AND COALESCE(w.watch_seconds, 0) >= :min_watch_seconds THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS effective_live_days
  FROM broadcast_days b LEFT JOIN watch_day w ON b.date = w.date AND b.streamer_id = w.streamer_id
  GROUP BY b.streamer_id
), base AS (
  SELECT s.streamer_id, s.tier AS streamer_tier,
         COALESCE(g.gift_amount_idr, 0) AS gift_amount_idr,
         COALESCE(w.watch_duration_hours, 0) AS watch_duration_hours,
         COALESCE(l.effective_live_days, 0) AS effective_live_days,
         COALESCE(l.live_duration_hours, 0) AS live_duration_hours,
         COALESCE(w.viewer_uv, 0) AS viewer_uv, b.allocated_units AS previous_units
  FROM streamer_profiles s LEFT JOIN watches w ON s.streamer_id = w.streamer_id
  LEFT JOIN gifts g ON s.streamer_id = g.streamer_id LEFT JOIN live l ON s.streamer_id = l.streamer_id
  LEFT JOIN boost_snapshots b ON s.streamer_id = b.streamer_id AND b.date = :previous_snapshot_date
), suggested AS (
  SELECT streamer_id, streamer_tier, gift_amount_idr, watch_duration_hours, effective_live_days,
         live_duration_hours, viewer_uv, previous_units,
         CASE WHEN effective_live_days >= :boost_days AND viewer_uv >= :boost_viewers THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS eligible,
         CASE WHEN effective_live_days >= :boost_days AND viewer_uv >= :boost_viewers THEN :boost_units ELSE 0 END AS suggested_units
  FROM base
)
SELECT streamer_id, streamer_tier, gift_amount_idr, watch_duration_hours, effective_live_days,
       live_duration_hours, viewer_uv, eligible, previous_units, suggested_units,
       suggested_units - previous_units AS delta_units,
       CASE WHEN previous_units IS NULL THEN 'review_missing_snapshot'
            WHEN suggested_units > previous_units THEN 'increase'
            WHEN suggested_units < previous_units THEN 'decrease' ELSE 'keep' END AS action,
       CASE WHEN eligible = 1 THEN '达到有效开播与观众门槛' ELSE '未达到有效开播或观众门槛' END AS reason
FROM suggested ORDER BY eligible DESC, watch_duration_hours DESC, streamer_id

WITH streamer_profiles AS (SELECT streamer_id, tier, category FROM streamers), watch_events AS (SELECT date, user_id AS viewer_id, streamer_id, duration_seconds FROM view_sessions WHERE date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date AND streamer_id IN (SELECT streamer_id FROM streamer_profiles)), gift_events AS (SELECT date, streamer_id, amount_idr FROM transactions WHERE date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date AND streamer_id IN (SELECT streamer_id FROM streamer_profiles)), broadcast_days AS (SELECT date, streamer_id, live_seconds FROM streamer_daily WHERE date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date AND streamer_id IN (SELECT streamer_id FROM streamer_profiles)), boost_snapshots AS (SELECT date, streamer_id, allocated_units FROM traffic_boost_daily WHERE date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date AND streamer_id IN (SELECT streamer_id FROM streamer_profiles)), campaign_members AS (SELECT campaign_id, streamer_id FROM campaign_streamers WHERE streamer_id IN (SELECT streamer_id FROM streamer_profiles)), watch_day AS (SELECT date, streamer_id, SUM(duration_seconds) AS watch_seconds FROM watch_events GROUP BY date, streamer_id), watches AS (SELECT streamer_id, SUM(duration_seconds) / 3600.0 AS watch_duration_hours, COUNT(DISTINCT viewer_id) AS viewer_uv FROM watch_events GROUP BY streamer_id), gifts AS (SELECT streamer_id, SUM(amount_idr) AS gift_amount_idr FROM gift_events GROUP BY streamer_id), live AS (SELECT b.streamer_id, SUM(b.live_seconds) / 3600.0 AS live_duration_hours, SUM(CASE WHEN b.live_seconds > 0 AND b.live_seconds >= :min_live_seconds AND COALESCE(w.watch_seconds, 0) >= :min_watch_seconds THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS effective_live_days FROM broadcast_days AS b LEFT JOIN watch_day AS w ON b.date = w.date AND b.streamer_id = w.streamer_id GROUP BY b.streamer_id), base AS (SELECT s.streamer_id, s.tier AS streamer_tier, COALESCE(g.gift_amount_idr, 0) AS gift_amount_idr, COALESCE(w.watch_duration_hours, 0) AS watch_duration_hours, COALESCE(l.effective_live_days, 0) AS effective_live_days, COALESCE(l.live_duration_hours, 0) AS live_duration_hours, COALESCE(w.viewer_uv, 0) AS viewer_uv, b.allocated_units AS previous_units FROM streamer_profiles AS s LEFT JOIN watches AS w ON s.streamer_id = w.streamer_id LEFT JOIN gifts AS g ON s.streamer_id = g.streamer_id LEFT JOIN live AS l ON s.streamer_id = l.streamer_id LEFT JOIN boost_snapshots AS b ON s.streamer_id = b.streamer_id AND b.date = :previous_snapshot_date), suggested AS (SELECT streamer_id, streamer_tier, gift_amount_idr, watch_duration_hours, effective_live_days, live_duration_hours, viewer_uv, previous_units, CASE WHEN effective_live_days >= :boost_days AND viewer_uv >= :boost_viewers THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS eligible, CASE WHEN effective_live_days >= :boost_days AND viewer_uv >= :boost_viewers THEN :boost_units ELSE 0 END AS suggested_units FROM base) SELECT streamer_id, streamer_tier, gift_amount_idr, watch_duration_hours, effective_live_days, live_duration_hours, viewer_uv, eligible, previous_units, suggested_units, suggested_units - previous_units AS delta_units, CASE WHEN previous_units IS NULL THEN 'review_missing_snapshot' WHEN suggested_units > previous_units THEN 'increase' WHEN suggested_units < previous_units THEN 'decrease' ELSE 'keep' END AS action, CASE WHEN eligible = 1 THEN '达到有效开播与观众门槛' ELSE '未达到有效开播或观众门槛' END AS reason FROM suggested ORDER BY eligible DESC, watch_duration_hours DESC, streamer_id
